Inside the glass burns a flame of eerie phosphor green, the brightest thing in the picture, and its cold green light spills over the brass and the nearest rocks, fading into the black of the cave behind.

what: a tall stone archway in a dark dungeon wall, its opening filled with a glowing swirl of hellish red light. Standing in the middle of the opening, facing the viewer, is an ordinary farm cow: a real black-and-white dairy cow with a pink nose, short curved pale horns and an iron bell on a strap round her neck, calmly chewing and looking out with mild, puzzled eyes. She is completely calm and unharmed, and plainly out of place, which is the joke. Her front is lit by soft light from the upper left, and the red light behind outlines her.

what: the Cow King, the war-king of the hell cattle, seen close from the chest up before a hellish red sky: a huge grim bull-headed warrior king, painted as seriously as a minotaur lord, never comic. He has the head of a real fighting bull: a broad heavy scarred muzzle with flaring nostrils and a thick iron ring through the nose, small fierce glowing red eyes, and two long thick forward-curving pale horn-grey horns banded with tarnished gold; between the horns sits a heavy tarnished dark gold crown with tall square points. His head and neck are covered in short coarse piebald hide, black with big white patches and a broad white blaze down his black face. He wears blackened iron shoulder plates edged with dull gold, a coat of blackened iron scales and a long ragged dark wine-purple royal cape with a dull grey-white fur collar, and grips the dark shaft of a halberd with a bright steel axe-head beside him.
colours: Short coarse piebald hide, black with big white patches and a white blaze; a dark grey muzzle with an iron nose ring; glowing red eyes; pale horn-grey horns banded with tarnished gold; a tarnished dark gold crown; blackened iron armour with dull gold edges; a dark wine-purple cape with a grey-white fur collar; a halberd with a dark shaft and bright steel head; a hellish red sky.
must_show: a crowned black-and-white bull-headed king
a nose ring
a halberd
red sky behind
